# Árbol de talentos en anillos — Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Replace the 66-node talent circle with a ~280-node tree of seven closed, interlinked rings, generated by script with per-class recommended routes, shown in a full-screen holographic window with zoom, drag and stat icons in frames.

**Architecture:** `tools/data/make_talents.mjs` builds the tree and the routes from rules and writes `data/talents.json`. `sim/progression` keeps the same rules minus the ring gating (every node buyable from the start). `ui/talents_window.gd` becomes a pannable, zoomable canvas drawn by code. Old characters lose their talents and keep their points (save version 8).

**Tech Stack:** Node (generator, `node --test`), Godot 4.7 GDScript (GUT tests).

**Spec:** [[Plan 8.3g — Árbol de talentos en anillos (spec)]]

## Global Constraints
- Nodes only give stats from this list (no abilities): attack_power_pct, spell_power_pct, crit_add, crit_damage_add, damage_done_pct, damage_taken_pct, move_speed_pct, dodge_add, block_add, armor_add, armor_pct, max_hp_pct, hp_regen_add, lifesteal_add, healing_done_pct, healing_received_pct, max_resource_pct, resource_regen_pct, cooldown_reduction_add, threat_pct.
- One tree for every class; every node buyable from the start through a bought neighbour (no ring or upgrade gating).
- 1 point per level above 1 (`Talents.points` unchanged); masteries unchanged once a direction's nodes are all owned.
- Window: HoloTheme blue, fits 1280×720, no scrolled lists (map with zoom and drag).
- Texts in Spanish in `data/texts/textos.csv`; code and commits in English.
- `data/talents.json` written with `formatJson` (compact).

## Review Focus
- An old character (ids like `might_3`, `arcane_key`) loads with no talents, no masteries and all its points free — test in Task 3.
- A drag that starts on a node must pan, not buy (press and release more than 4 px apart) — test in Task 4.
- Clicking a node that is not buyable (locked, owned, no points) never emits `talent_bought` — test in Task 4.
- A node whose icon file is missing draws the fallback and does not error — test in Task 4.
- The detail panel never leaves the screen when the hovered node is near an edge — test in Task 4.

---

### Task 1: Generator — rings, stats, kinds, icons, links

**Files:**
- Modify: `tools/data/make_talents.mjs` (rewrite; keep the CLI: running it writes `data/talents.json`)
- Create: `tools/data/tests/talents.test.mjs`

**Interfaces:**
- Produces: `export function buildTree() -> {start: "start", directions: [...5], nodes: {id: {kind, dir, mix, ring, x, y, icon, mods, links}}}`; node ids `start` and `r<ring>_<index>`; `kind` in `start|minor|notable|keystone`; `dir` the nearest pure direction (`might|celerity|vitality|bastion|arcane`); `mix` the neighbour direction for blended nodes, else `""`; `icon` an icon file name without extension; `mods` `[{type: "stat", stat, value}]`.
- Produces: `export const STAT_ICON` (stat → icon name) and `export const BASE` (stat → ring-1 value).

Rules (decided here, not in the spec):
- Rings 1..7 with `10 × ring` nodes (280 + start). Node `i` of ring `r` sits at angle `θ = 2π·i/count` clockwise from the top; radius `0.13·r`; `x = sin θ · R`, `y = −cos θ · R` (rounded to 5 decimals).
- Directions centred at 0°, 72°, 144°, 216°, 288° in the order might, celerity, vitality, bastion, arcane. `dir` = nearest centre; `t` = signed offset from it / 36° (−1..1); `mix` = the neighbour on the side of `t` when `|t| ≥ 0.4`, else `""`.
- Stat pools: might [attack_power_pct, crit_add, crit_damage_add, damage_done_pct]; celerity [move_speed_pct, dodge_add, cooldown_reduction_add]; vitality [hp_regen_add, lifesteal_add, healing_done_pct, healing_received_pct]; bastion [armor_pct, max_hp_pct, block_add, armor_add, damage_taken_pct, threat_pct]; arcane [spell_power_pct, max_resource_pct, resource_regen_pct].
- `BASE`: attack_power_pct 0.03, crit_add 0.01, crit_damage_add 0.05, damage_done_pct 0.02, move_speed_pct 0.03, dodge_add 0.01, cooldown_reduction_add 0.02, hp_regen_add 1, lifesteal_add 0.01, healing_done_pct 0.03, healing_received_pct 0.03, armor_pct 0.04, armor_add 15, max_hp_pct 0.03, block_add 0.02, damage_taken_pct −0.02, threat_pct 0.1, spell_power_pct 0.03, max_resource_pct 0.04, resource_regen_pct 0.05. Ring multiplier `1 + (r − 1)/6` (×1 to ×2).
- Kinds: `keystone` on rings 4 and 7 at the five direction centres (`t = 0`); else `notable` when `r ≥ 2 and i % 5 == 2`; else `minor`.
- Mods: minor pure → 1 stat `pool[dir][(r + i) % len]` × ring mult; minor blended → that stat ×0.6 plus `pool[mix][(r + i) % len]` ×0.6; notable → two stats of `dir` (`k` and `k+1` of the pool) ×1, plus one of `mix` ×0.5 when blended; keystone → the first two stats of `dir`'s pool ×2.5. `icon` = `STAT_ICON[mods[0].stat]`.
- `STAT_ICON`: the 20 stats map to the 19 files in `assets/icons/talents/` (armor_pct and armor_add → `armor`; cooldown_reduction_add → `cooldown`; the rest drop the `_pct`/`_add` suffix: attack_power, spell_power, crit, crit_damage, damage_done, damage_taken, move_speed, dodge, block, max_hp, hp_regen, lifesteal, healing_done, healing_received, max_resource, resource_regen, threat).
- Links (symmetric): each ring closed (`i ↔ i+1 mod count`); every ring-1 node ↔ `start`; ring `r ≥ 2` node `i` with even `i` ↔ ring `r−1` node `round(i · count(r−1) / count(r)) mod count(r−1)`.

  - `test("five keystones on rings 4 and 7, notables between")`: 10 keystones; ≥ 40 notables; each keystone's `dir` matches its angle.

### Task 2: Generator — recommended routes per class

**Files:**
- Modify: `tools/data/make_talents.mjs`
- Modify: `tools/data/tests/talents.test.mjs`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `buildTree()` (Task 1).
- Produces: `export function buildRoutes(tree) -> {class_id: [node ids]}` for warrior, cleric, mage, archer, assassin; written in `data/talents.json` as `"routes"`.

Rules:
- `PRIORITIES` (stat → weight): warrior {armor_pct 3, max_hp_pct 3, attack_power_pct 3, block_add 2, damage_taken_pct 2, armor_add 2, threat_pct 1, crit_add 1, hp_regen_add 1}; cleric {healing_done_pct 3, spell_power_pct 3, max_resource_pct 2, resource_regen_pct 2, max_hp_pct 1, armor_pct 1, cooldown_reduction_add 1}; mage {spell_power_pct 3, crit_add 2, crit_damage_add 2, max_resource_pct 2, resource_regen_pct 2, cooldown_reduction_add 2}; archer {attack_power_pct 3, crit_add 3, crit_damage_add 2, move_speed_pct 2, dodge_add 2, damage_done_pct 2}; assassin {attack_power_pct 3, crit_damage_add 3, crit_add 2, dodge_add 2, damage_done_pct 2, lifesteal_add 2, move_speed_pct 1}.
- `score(node) = Σ weight(stat) · |value| / |BASE[stat]|`.
- Greedy, 100 steps: among unowned nodes linked to `start` or to a route node, pick the max of `score(n) + 0.5 · max(score of n's unowned neighbours)`; ties → lower ring, then lower index.

- [ ] **Step 1: Failing tests:** `test("each class route has 100 distinct nodes, each linked to the start or an earlier node")`; `test("routes follow the class: the warrior's first 30 nodes are mostly bastion or might, the mage's mostly arcane")` (≥ 60 % of the first 30 nodes have `dir` in the set).
- [ ] **Step 2: Run** → FAIL.
- [ ] **Step 3: Implement `buildRoutes(tree)`**; the CLI writes `routes`.
- [ ] **Step 4: Run** → PASS; regenerate `data/talents.json`.
- [ ] **Step 5: Commit** `feat: recommended talent routes per class`.

### Task 4: The holographic talent window

**Files:**
- Modify: `ui/talents_window.gd` (rewrite the layout and `TalentCanvas`; keep the signals `talent_bought(id)`, `mastery_bought(dir)` and the public methods used by `game/main.gd` and the tests: `show_for`, `refresh`, `select`, `selected`, `node_state`, `description_text`, `points_text`, `masteries_visible`, `mastery_enabled`, `press_mastery`, `panel_rect`, `node_screen_position`, `click_at`)
- Modify: `data/texts/textos.csv` (new keys below)
- Test: `tests/unit/ui/test_talents_window.gd`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `TalentDB.route(class_id)` (Task 3), node fields `icon`, `kind`, `dir`, `mix`, `ring`, `x`, `y` (Task 1).
- `show_for(progress: PlayerProgress, db: TalentDB, balance: Balance, class_id: String = "")` — the class picks the route.
- New: `zoom_to(z: float)` (clamped 0.5–2.5), `zoom() -> float`, `pan_by(delta: Vector2)`, `set_route_visible(on: bool)`, `route_visible() -> bool`, `route_step(id: String) -> int` (1-based, 0 when not on the route), `hover_at(global_point: Vector2)`, `detail_rect() -> Rect2`, `press_at(p: Vector2)` / `release_at(p: Vector2)` (a release within 4 px of the press is a click; more is a pan).
- `node_state(id)` → `owned | available | locked` (no `ring_locked`).
- Click on an `available` node with free points emits `talent_bought(id)`; any other click only selects.

Look (HoloTheme): full-screen dim + panel; top bar with `UI_TALENTS_POINTS` ("Puntos libres: %d · Gastados: %d / %d"), the route CheckBox `UI_TALENTS_ROUTE` ("Ruta recomendada") and `UI_TALENTS_RESET` ("Reinicio con Maese Corwin: %d de oro", cost from `ProgressRequests.reset_cost(level, balance)`); masteries row at the bottom (existing rows). Canvas: tree positions × 620 px × zoom, centred; links 1 px HoloTheme line colour (owned–owned links cyan 2 px; route links dashed gold); nodes = icon texture `res://assets/icons/talents/<icon>.png` clipped to a circle of radius 11 (minor) / 16 (notable) / 22 (keystone) px at zoom 1, ring frame 2 px (minor), 3 px with four ticks (notable), 4 px plus a halo in the direction's colour (keystone); owned = full colour + cyan frame; available = full colour + light frame; locked = darkened 60 %. Missing icon → filled circle in the direction colour. Route steps: gold number every 5th step. Detail panel follows the hovered node, clamped inside the window: `node_title` (with `mix`), kind, `StatText.describe_all(mods)`, state, `UI_TALENTS_ROUTE_STEP` ("Paso %d de la ruta").
